result.rationale: D1 10th lord Sun + D10. Sun, Saturn, Mercury and the D10 10th lord Moon carry particular weight; Rahu is mixed but strengthened by its D10 conjunction with own-sign Saturn. Scores are relative within Mercury MD. In v4 the PD is the dominant operational layer: the AD supplies climate and the SD is a short-term modifier. The PD baseline is + (+23). Mercury SD plus the transit snapshot largely preserves that baseline. Midpoint gochara is a snapshot rather than the whole transit story; slow planets and exact contacts carry more weight than fast-planet midpoint positions. Extreme ++/−− requires convergence; intensity is tracked separately (LOW).
